## Problem or workflow

What is difficult today? Describe the use case without private session details.

## Proposed behavior

What should change, and how would a user interact with it?

## Safety and privacy

Could this affect live work, cleanup eligibility, collected data, or monitoring overhead? StaleBread does not automatically terminate processes.

## Alternatives

What other approaches have you considered?
